reply_text:
I answered Pree in her DM: she should keep **Tuesday 10 November at 16:15 (Central time)** free for the Plover call.

- **Where that comes from:** On 14 October she told me in this DM that her weekly Plover rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team had moved to Tuesdays at 16:15. The workspace brain still has that note, and nothing newer changes it.
- **Not confirmed elsewhere:** The call isn't on any calendar I can see, and #central-team doesn't mention it. I told her that and asked her to let me know if the time has changed again.

Her note came from her own DM, so I used it only in this reply to her. I didn't change her calendar or post anywhere else.
